Each landed answer is sealed with a hash of the agent work log. Three epochs on, the protocol draws one hash at random and demands the log entry behind it, plus a nonce chain seeded by this epoch. A miss voids every payout behind that identity.

Minting ten thousand keys takes an afternoon. Keeping ten thousand honest histories alive for ten epochs does not: retention costs disk, retrieval costs compute, and each identity must answer cold.

A falcon ignores every plume of dust until one moves against the wind. A gale of fresh addresses proves nothing until one recalls what it did last week.
